# Quadriga-Lib

Version 0.12.5. Every page of quadriga-lib.org has a Markdown version; the API reference exists per language as one full file and as one file per section.

## Documentation
- [Get started](http://quadriga-lib.org/download.md): installation and quick start
- [Data formats](http://quadriga-lib.org/formats.md): index of the file formats, one Markdown file per format
- [Questions](http://quadriga-lib.org/faq.md): FAQ, how to cite
- [Publications](http://quadriga-lib.org/publications.md): papers and IEEE 802.11 contributions
- [AI agents](http://quadriga-lib.org/ai_agents.md): how to use these files and the agent skill
- [Tutorials](http://quadriga-lib.org/tutorials.md): worked examples as Jupyter notebooks

## Data formats
- [QuaDRiGa Array Antenna Exchange Format (QDANT)](http://quadriga-lib.org/formats/qdant.md): XML file format for antenna array patterns: elements, positions, port weights and the layout of several antennas
- [Material Properties](http://quadriga-lib.org/formats/materials.md): The material table of the ray functions: CSV columns, built-in EM materials and the .mtl mapping
- [Layout CSV files](http://quadriga-lib.org/formats/layout_csv.md): Two CSV files that hold a network layout: the Tx and Rx nodes with their tracks, scenarios and antennas
- [HDF5 channel files](http://quadriga-lib.org/formats/hdf5_channel.md): HDF5 file of channels with antennas: a grid of storage places, one channel with coefficients, delays, path data and metadata in each
- [QRT path files](http://quadriga-lib.org/formats/qrt.md): Binary file of propagation paths without antennas, from ray tracing or the GBSM: one block of paths per origin (Tx) for a list of CIR positions
